nodes.question: What is the main focus of the Cleaner Logistics and Supply Chain 2022 publication?
nodes.answer: The main focus of the Cleaner Logistics and Supply Chain 2022 publication is to discuss advancements and strategies in creating more sustainable and environmentally friendly logistics and supply chain practices.
